g.title: G
g.text: Planned flows; excluded from P0 navigation

g.title: b
g.text: At most 2 gap questions per turn; skip allowed

g.title: e
g.text: Review gaps; edit and confirm answer

g.title: f
g.text: Stop, retry or keep selected feedback

g.title: note
g.text: P2 named recipients require matching authenticated identity.
Joining is not blanket sharing. Managers do not gain private interview access.
Human confirmation concerns exact claims and versions, not overall ability.
